verdict.rationale: Dialpad is a business phone platform, so call forwarding is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents forwarding a business number to a cell phone or setting away-from-desk routing rules. The closest item is an API call that adds a participant to a live call by phone, which is an adjacent capability and not forwarding.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
